Kuvitus: kesäsateen jälkeen pellon ja me: Illustration: after a summer shower a bright rainbow arches over a field and forest, red on its outer edge and violet on its inner edge. Outside it a fainter second rainbow is visible with the colours in the opposite order, and the sky between the arcs is darker. Grey rain clouds are in the background. In the foreground a person stands with their back to the viewer, looking at the arc.
Periaatekuva, ei mittakaavassa: valkoise: Schematic diagram, not to scale: a narrow beam of white light arrives from the lower left at the left side of a glass prism. In the prism the light splits into colours, and a fan leaves from the other side: red is deviated the least from its original direction and violet the most, with orange, yellow, green and blue between them. The colours hit a white screen on the right one below another, red at the top. The spreading of the colours is drawn larger than in reality.
Periaatekuva, ei mittakaavassa: suuri ve: Schematic diagram, not to scale: a large water droplet. A horizontal ray of white sunlight arrives from the left at the upper part of the droplet. At the point of incidence the normal is drawn as a dashed line, and the angle of incidence alpha and the angle of refraction beta are marked. In the droplet the light splits: the red and violet rays travel to the back wall of the droplet, are reflected from it and are refracted out of the lower part of the droplet towards the lower left. Violet leaves at a smaller angle than red. The difference between the colours is drawn larger than in reality.
Periaatekuva sivulta, kulmat eivät ole m: Schematic side view, angles not to scale: the observer stands on the right with their back to the sun, and the sun's rays arrive obliquely downwards from the upper right. A dashed line from the eye runs in the direction of the sun's rays, down to the left towards the antisolar point, which is below the horizon at the shadow of the observer's head. The upper droplet is at an angle of 42 degrees from this direction, and red light reaches the eye from it; its violet light passes above the eye. The lower droplet is at an angle of about 40.6 degrees, and violet light reaches the eye from it; its red light hits the ground in front of the observer.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: kruunulasin N-BK7: Graph to scale: the refractive index n of N-BK7 crown glass as a function of the vacuum wavelength lambda from 400 to 700 nm. Six measured points from the manufacturer's table: 405 nm 1.5302; 436 nm 1.5267; 486 nm 1.5224; 546 nm 1.5187; 589 nm 1.5167 and 656 nm 1.5143. The curve falls: at short wavelengths the refractive index is greatest, and the curve flattens towards red. Below the horizontal axis is a strip of the colours of visible light from violet to red.
Kaavakuva prismasta: yksivärinen säde tu: Diagram of a prism: a single-colour ray arrives from the left at the left side of the prism at an angle of incidence alpha 1 to the normal and is refracted in the glass to the angle alpha 2. The ray hits the right side at an angle of incidence alpha 3 and leaves the prism at an angle of refraction alpha 4. The normals of both surfaces are drawn as dashed lines. At the top of the prism is the apex angle A. The extension of the incident ray is drawn as a dashed line, and the angle between it and the emerging ray is the angle of deviation delta.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: punaisen valon (n: Graph to scale: a ray of red light (n = 1.332) leaves a water droplet at an angle theta from the direction of the antisolar point. The horizontal axis shows the angle of incidence alpha from 0 to 90 degrees and the vertical axis theta from 0 to 45 degrees. The curve rises from the origin, reaches its greatest value of 42.3 degrees when the angle of incidence is about 59.5 degrees, and then falls to about 15 degrees. Near the peak the curve is almost horizontal: over a wide range of angles of incidence the rays leave in almost the same direction.
Kuvitus: puutarhassa nurmikkoa kastellaa: Illustration: in a garden a lawn is being watered with a hose. A small rainbow is visible in the droplets of the water jet when the sun shines from behind the person watering.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: erään flinttilasi: Graph to scale: the refractive index n of a flint glass as a function of the vacuum wavelength lambda from 400 to 700 nm. Seven points at wavelengths 400, 450, 500, 550, 600, 650 and 700 nm and a falling curve through them. The grid spacing of the vertical axis is 0.002 and of the horizontal axis 50 nm.
Periaatekuva sivulta, kulmat eivät ole m: Schematic side view, angles not to scale: the viewer stands on the right with their back to the Sun, and the sunlight comes from the upper right obliquely down into the shower on the left. From the eye a dashed line runs along the sunlight down to the left towards the antisolar point, which is at the shadow of the viewer's head below the horizon. The upper drop is at an angle of 42 degrees from this direction, and red light from it reaches the eye; its violet light passes above the eye. The lower drop is at an angle of about 40.6 degrees, and violet light from it reaches the eye; its red light hits the ground in front of the viewer.
